sloka: दिव्याङ्गरागा वैदेहि दिव्याभरणभूषिता ।यानमारोह भद्रं ते भर्ता त्वां द्रष्टुमिच्छति ।। ६.११७.९ ।।
transliteration: divyāṅgarāgā vaidehi divyābharaṇabhūṣitā ।yānamāroha bhadraṁ te bhartā tvāṁ draṣṭumicchati ।। 6.117.9 ।।

translations.english: Then Vibheeshana, the prosperous Lord of the Rakshasas seeing Sita greeted her with palms joined together lifted it over his head (as a sign of respect).
